statement_scope: Whole original Problem 21.24: for every finite group G, define the undirected power graph P(G) on G by adjacency of distinct x,y when x lies in <y> or y lies in <x>, and ask whether P(G) being a cograph implies P(G) is chordal. The author Theorem1 answers yes for all finite groups, not merely the prime-power-element or nonabelian-simple cases cited in the question. Adjacent Problem21.23 on enhanced power graphs is definition/context only and is not counted.
